summary: Iteration 113: KARAU Phase 2 Employee Directory with CSV Import, LDAP Integration - All 28 backend tests PASSED (100%), All frontend UI elements verified with Playwright. Features: CSV upload with auto-column detection, employee CRUD (delete/update/status toggle), LDAP config/test/sync endpoints, employee stats with department breakdown, source tracking (manual/csv/ldap).

backend_api_tests: GET /api/karau-meet/organizations/{id}/ldap/config - Returns config with masked password (200)
GET /api/karau-meet/organizations/{id}/ldap/config - Returns configured=false if not set (200)
POST /api/karau-meet/organizations/{id}/ldap/test - Test LDAP connection (200, fails gracefully without real LDAP)
POST /api/karau-meet/organizations/{id}/ldap/sync - Sync from LDAP (200, fails gracefully)
Regression: GET /api/karau-meet/organizations/tiers/info - Still returns all tiers (200)
Regression: GET /api/karau-meet/organizations/{id}/rooms - Room endpoints still work (200)
Regression: GET /api/karau-meet/organizations/branding/by-domain - Branding endpoint still works (200)
Regression: GET /api/karau-meet/organizations/{id}/employees?search= - Last name search still works (200)
frontend_ui_tests: MedMatch Inc organization selected with Grande tier badge
Stats section displays: 15 Active, 2 Inactive, 7 Departments, 17 Total Records
Test and Sync Now buttons present
CSV upload area opens with file input (data-testid=csv-upload-area, csv-file-input)
LDAP config form opens with Server URL, Bind DN, Bind Password, Base DN, User Filter, Email Attribute fields (data-testid=ldap-config-form)
Add Employee form opens with Email, First Name, Last Name, Department, Title fields (data-testid=add-employee-form)
Employee search by last name works - 'Smith' filters to 1 result
Employee list shows 15 employees with status indicators (green dots)
CSV badges visible on employees imported via CSV
Department breakdown shows: Engineering(5), Sales(2), HR(2), Test(2), Marketing(2), New Department(1), IT(1)

critical_code_review_comments: Backend: CSV upload correctly uses multipart/form-data with flexible column detection
Backend: Password masking in LDAP config GET endpoint works (shows '••••••••')
Backend: LDAP test/sync endpoints fail gracefully when no real LDAP server available
Backend: Employee status toggle correctly adjusts org employee_count
Backend: Stats endpoint provides useful department and source breakdowns
Frontend: EmployeesTab component has all required data-testids for testing
Frontend: CSV upload area shows column format guidance
Frontend: LDAP config form has all necessary fields with placeholders
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed organizations and employees created during pytest run. CSV import tests added employees with csv_import source.
context_for_next_testing_agent: KARAU Phase 2 Employee Directory fully tested. CSV upload supports flexible column names (email/Email Address/etc), handles duplicates/invalid emails gracefully. LDAP endpoints work but require real AD server to sync - returns success=false with error message when no server available. Employee stats shows active/inactive counts, department breakdown, and source tracking (manual/csv_import/ldap_sync). To access Enterprise admin: navigate to /karau-meet/enterprise, login as admin@medmatch.com, click Employees tab. MedMatch Inc org has 17 employees from various sources.

csv_upload.error_handling: Tracks duplicate emails, invalid emails, tier limit exceeded
csv_upload.response: added count, error count, detected columns

employee_crud.delete: DELETE /employees/{emp_id} - removes and decrements org count
employee_crud.update: PUT /employees/{emp_id} - updates email, name, department, title

employee_stats.returns: total, active, inactive, departments array, sources dict

ldap_integration.configure: POST /ldap/configure - saves server_url, bind_dn, bind_password, base_dn, user_filter, etc.
ldap_integration.get_config: GET /ldap/config - returns config with masked password
ldap_integration.sync: POST /ldap/sync - pulls users from LDAP, creates/updates employees
